ucs.title: [LLM] Midnight Blizzard (APT29) OAuth/service-principal credential injection
ucs.description: Detects secrets, certificates, or password credentials being added to existing Entra ID app registrations or service principals — the signature persistence move from the January 2024 Microsoft corporate-tenant intrusion (Midnight Blizzard / SVR / Nobelium), where the actor implanted credentials on a legacy OAuth app holding elevated Office 365 Exchange Online permissions to read executive mailboxes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Change.src) as src_ip values(Change.user) as actor values(Change.object) as target_app values(Change.command) as command from datamodel=Change where Change.object_category="application" AND Change.action="modified" AND (Change.command IN ("Add service principal credentials","Update application – Certificates and secrets management","Update application","Update service principal","Add application","Consent to application")) by Change.dest Change.result | `drop_dm_object_name(Change)` | search command="*credential*" OR command="*application*" OR command="*Consent*" | join type=left actor [| tstats summariesonly=false values(Authentication.src) as auth_src values(Authentication.signature) as auth_risk from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.app="azure*" by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as actor | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`] | eval risk=case(like(command,"%credential%"),"high", like(command,"%Consent%"),"high", 1=1,"medium") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime actor src_ip target_app command risk auth_src | sort -lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Midnight Blizzard signature — secret/cert added to a service principal or app registration
let HighValueScopes = dynamic(["full_access_as_app","Mail.ReadWrite","Mail.Read","Exchange.ManageAsApp","Directory.ReadWrite.All","Application.ReadWrite.All","AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All","RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory"]);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where Application in ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
| where ActionType in (
    "Add service principal credentials.",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management ",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management",
    "Update application",
    "Update service principal",
    "Add application.",
    "Consent to application.",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal.",
    "Add delegated permission grant."
  )
| extend Raw = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend ModifiedProperties = tostring(Raw.ModifiedProperties)
| extend TargetApp = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)
| extend ConsentedScopes = tostring(Raw.ModifiedProperties)
| where ModifiedProperties has_any ("KeyIdentifier","PasswordCredential","KeyCredentials","ConsentType")
   or ActionType has "credentials"
   or ConsentedScopes has_any (HighValueScopes)
| project Timestamp, Actor=AccountDisplayName, ActorUpn=AccountId, IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP,
          IsAnonymousProxy, IsAdminOperation, ActionType, TargetApp, ModifiedProperties, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Midnight Blizzard / Nobelium app-credential implantation pattern
let HighValueScopes = dynamic(["full_access_as_app","Mail.ReadWrite","Mail.Read","Exchange.ManageAsApp","Directory.ReadWrite.All","Application.ReadWrite.All","AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All","RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Category =~ "ApplicationManagement"
| where OperationName in (
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management",
    "Update application",
    "Update service principal",
    "Add application",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal",
    "Add delegated permission grant",
    "Consent to application"
  )
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend ActorAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId)
| extend TargetApp = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend ModifiedProps = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties)
| where ModifiedProps has_any ("KeyIdentifier","PasswordCredential","KeyCredentials")
   or OperationName has "credentials"
   or ModifiedProps has_any (HighValueScopes)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, ActorIp, ActorAppId, TargetApp, OperationName, Result, ResultReason, ModifiedProps, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Add service principal credentials" OR "Update application – Certificates and secrets management" OR "Update application" OR "Update service principal" OR "Add application" OR "Consent to application" OR "Add delegated permission grant" OR "Add app role assignment to service principal") @properties.result:success
ucs.rationale: App-credential implantation on existing service principals is the exact TTP MSRC attributed to Midnight Blizzard in the Jan 2024 disclosure (SRC link: msrc/blog/2024/01). APT29 prefers credential addition over new-app creation because it inherits the victim app's existing admin consent and high-privilege Exchange Online grants — bypassing consent prompts entirely. ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 low-and-slow password spray from residential/anonymized proxy → first-time successful sign-in
ucs.description: Chains a low-volume password spray against an Entra ID tenant sourced from anonymous / Tor / residential-proxy infrastructure to the first successful authentication of any sprayed user from the same egress IP — the initial-access pattern Midnight Blizzard used against the Microsoft corporate tenant (legacy non-production test account, no MFA) and HPE in 2023-2024.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count as fail_count, dc(Authentication.user) as failed_users, values(Authentication.user) as sprayed_users, min(_time) as spray_first, max(_time) as spray_last from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="failure" Authentication.app="azure*" (Authentication.signature_id IN (50053,50126,50055,50056,50057,50064,50140) OR Authentication.reason="InvalidUserNameOrPassword") by Authentication.src _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | where failed_users >= 20 AND fail_count < (failed_users * 5) | join type=inner src [| tstats summariesonly=false min(_time) as success_time, values(Authentication.user) as success_user, values(Authentication.app) as success_app, values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app="azure*" by Authentication.src | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`] | where success_time >= spray_first AND success_time <= (spray_last + 86400) | eval sprayed_str=mvjoin(sprayed_users,",") | eval hit=if(match(sprayed_str,success_user),"sprayed-user-then-authed","different-user-same-ip") | table spray_first spray_last src failed_users fail_count sprayed_users success_time success_user success_app ua hit | sort -spray_last
ucs.kql:
// APT29 / Midnight Blizzard initial-access pattern: anonymized-source spray → first success
let SprayWindow = 1h;
let MinFailedAccounts = 20;     // 20 distinct sprayed users in one hour — well above legit user-typo noise
let MaxAttemptsPerUser = 5;     // low-and-slow: <=5 attempts each, dodges per-account lockout
let Sprayers = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ErrorCode in (50053, 50126, 50055, 50056, 50057, 50064, 50140)
    | where IsAnonymousProxy == true
        or NetworkLocationDetails has_any ("anonymizedNetwork","proxy","tor")
        or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
    | summarize FailedUsers = dcount(AccountUpn),
                AttemptCount = count(),
                SprayedUsers = make_set(AccountUpn, 50),
                Errors = make_set(ErrorCode),
                SprayFirst = min(Timestamp),
                SprayLast  = max(Timestamp)
                by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, SprayWindow)
    | where FailedUsers >= MinFailedAccounts
      and AttemptCount <= (FailedUsers * MaxAttemptsPerUser);
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where ClientAppUsed !in ("Browser")   // APT29 historically prefers non-interactive ROPC / device-code flows
   or IsInteractive == false
| join kind=inner Sprayers on IPAddress
| where Timestamp between (SprayFirst .. SprayLast + 24h)
| extend WasSprayedTarget = iff(SprayedUsers has AccountUpn, "yes-sprayed-then-authed", "different-user-same-ip")
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, NetworkLocationDetails,
          Application, ResourceDisplayName, UserAgent, ClientAppUsed, IsInteractive,
          FailedUsers, AttemptCount, SprayedUsers, Errors, SprayFirst, SprayLast, WasSprayedTarget
| order by Timestamp asc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT29 / Midnight Blizzard: anonymized-source spray → first successful auth same IP
let SprayWindow = 1h;
let MinFailedAccounts = 20;
let MaxAttemptsPerUser = 5;
let Sprayers = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ResultType in (50053, 50126, 50055, 50056, 50057, 50064, 50140)
    | extend NetLoc = tostring(NetworkLocationDetails)
    | extend RiskTypes = tostring(RiskEventTypes)
    | where NetLoc has_any ("anonymizedNetwork","proxy","tor")
        or RiskTypes has_any ("anonymizedIPAddress","unfamiliarFeatures","passwordSpray")
        or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
    | summarize FailedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
                AttemptCount = count(),
                SprayedUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 50),
                Errors = make_set(ResultType),
                SprayFirst = min(TimeGenerated),
                SprayLast  = max(TimeGenerated)
                by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, SprayWindow)
    | where FailedUsers >= MinFailedAccounts
      and AttemptCount <= (FailedUsers * MaxAttemptsPerUser);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where ClientAppUsed !in ("Browser") or IsInteractive == false
| join kind=inner Sprayers on IPAddress
| where TimeGenerated between (SprayFirst .. SprayLast + 24h)
| extend WasSprayedTarget = iff(SprayedUsers has UserPrincipalName, "yes-sprayed-then-authed", "different-user-same-ip")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName,
          ResourceDisplayName, UserAgent, ClientAppUsed, IsInteractive,
          FailedUsers, AttemptCount, SprayedUsers, Errors, SprayFirst, SprayLast, WasSprayedTarget
| order by TimeGenerated asc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:"Sign-in activity" @properties.status.errorCode:(50053 OR 50126 OR 50055 OR 50056 OR 50057 OR 50064 OR 50140) (@properties.riskEventTypes:(anonymizedIPAddress OR passwordSpray) OR @properties.riskLevelDuringSignIn:(high OR medium) OR @network.client.geoip.anonymous:true)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog AuthenticationProvider=AzureAD
| EventOutcome=Failed
| regex("anonymized|proxy|tor", field=NetworkLocationDetails)
| groupBy([RemoteAddressIP4], function=[count(field=UserPrincipal, distinct=true, as=FailedUsers), count(as=AttemptCount), min(@timestamp, as=SprayFirst), max(@timestamp, as=SprayLast)])
| FailedUsers >= 20
| AttemptCount <= FailedUsers*5
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog AuthenticationProvider=AzureAD EventOutcome=Success | groupBy([RemoteAddressIP4], function=[min(@timestamp, as=SuccessTime), collect([UserPrincipal])])}, field=RemoteAddressIP4)
| SuccessTime >= SprayFirst
| SuccessTime <= SprayLast + 86400000
ucs.rationale: MSRC's Midnight Blizzard incident report (Jan 2024) explicitly called out the actor for (a) password-spray volume kept low to evade detection, (b) sourced through residential-proxy networks to blend into normal user geos, and (c) targeted at a legacy non-production OAuth-enabled account without MFA.
